old: Every accounting for changing has a move, applying twice, returning what it reaches. Negation, and not-not is that thing again. Reflection, and reflecting twice returns its facing. Time reversal, charge conjugation, parity, each squaring to the identity. Complex conjugation. Additive inverse and multiplicative inverse. Transpose. Legendre transform, twice, returning its potential, which is how a thermodynamics exchanges which of its terms stands independent. Set complement.
new: Each accounting for changing has a move, applying twice, returning the thing it reaches. Negation: not-not is that thing again. Reflection: reflecting twice returns its facing. Time reversal, charge conjugation and parity, each squaring to the identity; time reversal squares to the identity at an even number of fermions, and at an odd number it squares to minus the identity, a state returning with its sign changing. Complex conjugation. Additive inverse and multiplicative inverse. Transpose. Legendre transform, twice, returning its potential, a thermodynamics exchanging by it which of its terms stands independent. Set complement.

old: Each is an involution, and an accounting for changing reaches no other shape: an accounting returns what it reaches, or it accounts for nothing and no ledger closes.
new: Each is an involution, and an accounting for changing reaches this one shape: an accounting returns the thing it reaches, or it accounts for nothing and its ledger is-not closing.

old: Each involution but two has a fixed set, where its move returns its argument as it is; negation and set complement have none, negation being changing and changing back itself, a binary's own move with no place where it takes a counting from. Zero for additive inverse. Unity and minus unity for multiplicative. Reals for conjugation. Centre for parity. Neutral for charge conjugation. Equilibrium for time reversal. Symmetric for transpose. And with each accounting its fixed set is where it takes its counting from.
new: Each involution but two has a fixed set, at which its move returns its argument as it is; negation and set complement have none, negation being changing and changing back, a binary's own move, with no place to take a counting from. Zero for additive inverse. Unity and minus unity for multiplicative. Reals for conjugation. Centre for parity. Neutral for charge conjugation. Equilibrium for time reversal. Symmetric for transpose. With each accounting, its fixed set is the place it takes its counting from.

old: So accountings and floors are one thing, a self observing it two ways. An involution is a floor stating its move, and a floor is an involution dropping its move.
new: Accountings and floors are one thing, a self observing it two ways. An involution is a floor stating its move, and a floor is an involution dropping its move.

old: With an involution a self returns its own parity after two turns, and no place is of it.
new: With an involution a self returns its own parity after two steps, and its returning is at no place.

old: A fixed set is where both turns collapse to one — where a changing reaches no other to change back with, and a move and its returning are one same move. It is no location an object occupies. It is where a changing reaches nothing to change back against.
new: A fixed set is both steps collapsing to one: a changing reaching no other to change back with, a move and its returning one same move. It is-not a location an object occupies; it is a changing reaching nothing to change back against.

old: So every accounting sets its zero where its own changing reaches nothing, and counts outward from there. Which is why two ends a self finds with every floor are both ends: no coupling at all, and every member agreeing so completely that no parity goes across. Both are conditions where a changing reaches nothing to change back with, and an involution's fixing is exactly that.
new: Each accounting sets its zero at its own changing reaching nothing, and counts outward from there. A self finds two ends with each floor: bi-coupling at none, and each member agreeing so completely that no parity goes across. Both are a changing reaching nothing to change back with, and an involution's fixing is exactly that.

old: A balance point of a symmetric thing rides its own axis of balance by what such a point is. A self recognises an axis and does not derive it, and nothing more basic than symmetry stands to derive a seating from. Freeing, a fixed set stands as a coupling and no place: a bounding-zeroing a coupling reaches, is-or-is-not, inverting with each momentary. An involution stands, its proof standing, nothing altering it. A place goes.
new: A balance point of a symmetric thing rides its own axis of balance by its being such a point. A self recognises an axis and does not derive it, symmetry standing with nothing more basic beneath it to derive a seating from. Loosening, a fixed set stands as a bi-coupling and at no place: a bounding-zeroing a bi-coupling reaches, is-or-is-not, inverting with each momentary. An involution stands, its proof standing, unaltering. A place goes.

old: A three goes as a state or as a flow and not both, and both change and change back. A state-three counts what stands and has no rate; a flow-three goes one at a time and counts nothing. Neither reversing its other, and both ways forward.
new: A three goes as a state or as a flow, one at a time, and both change and change back. A state-three counts the things standing and is rateless; a flow-three goes one at a time and counts nothing. Neither reverses its other, and both ways go forward.

old: This is why an accounting returns three and not four. A total is a state-three, a level is a state-three, a direction is a flow-three, and a fourth comes nowhere, since state and flow is all of what changes and changes back. A cube's moves reach one twelfth of its assemblies, parting by three books conserving, corners twisting by threes, edges flipping by twos and a permutation's parity by twos: an accounting's three with a ledger, a field's instance of it and no proof beneath it.
new: An accounting returns three, and a fourth is-not: a total is a state-three, a level is a state-three, a direction is a flow-three, state and flow being each thing that changes and changes back. A cube's moves reach one twelfth of its assemblies, parting by three books conserving, corners twisting by threes, edges flipping by twos and a permutation's parity by twos: an accounting's three with a ledger, a field's instance of it, with no proof beneath it. A rotary motor's three units step its round in 80-degree and 40-degree portions as its field reports them, each unit open, loose and tight as its field describes them.

old: And it is where every accounting comes short: with a changing between state and flow. State to flow is where a count exhausts; flow to state is where a rate lands. With an account holding only state-threes, it fixes a flow as pieces; with an account holding only flow-threes, it fixes a standing as a rate. Every ghost stands with one of two changings — a level fixing where a flow goes, or a store fixing where a same-existing goes.
new: And each accounting comes short at a changing between state and flow. State to flow is a count exhausting; flow to state is a rate landing. An account of state-threes alone fixes a flow as pieces; an account of flow-threes alone fixes a standing as a rate. Each ghost stands with one of two changings: a level fixing where a flow goes, or a store fixing where a same-existing goes.

old: An accounting has counts, levels and rates, and a changing between a state and a flow is none of these three. A tipping enumerates nothing, so it is no count. A tipping is of its own rate, relating to no other living rate, so no clock measures it. It is a parity a self takes with a between, binary, of no size, and an accounting has no column for a thing of no size.
new: An accounting has counts, levels and rates, and a changing between a state and a flow is-not one of these three. A tipping enumerates nothing: it is-not a count. A tipping is of its own rate, relating to no other living rate: a clock is-not measuring it. It is a parity a self takes with a between, binary and sizeless, and an accounting's columns are for sized things.

old: So an accounting falls short nowhere with a changing. It has nothing that could reach one, and it converts what it reaches to the nearest thing it has — a level where a flow reaches a standing, a rate where a standing opens to a flow.
new: An accounting falls short of a changing at no one place: it has nothing reaching one, and it converts the thing it reaches to the nearest thing it has, a level as a flow reaches a standing, a rate as a standing opens to a flow.

old: And every instrument fixes to a clock all share while each self paces its own, so an instrument fixes a tipping where its clock falls rather than where a tipping falls. What survives an observing is where members happen to agree with a clock all share.
new: And each instrument fixes to a clock all share while each self paces its own, an instrument fixing a tipping at its clock's tick rather than at the tipping. An observing's surviving finding is members happening to agree with a clock all share. Closure phase shows a relation free of each station's own reference: around a triangle of three stations, the product of the visibilities keeps none of the stations' own phases, additive noise and baseline errors remaining.

old: A geodesic method has no clock, no floor and no magnitude, and is co-linear with a changing itself, where an accounting forks. That is what makes it a competency method rather than a better accounting — and it leaves an accounting competent with everything it does hold, counting, levelling, rating and closing states and flows, with nothing against its arithmetic anywhere.
new: A geodesic method is clockless, floorless and free of a magnitude, co-linear with a changing, where an accounting forks. This makes it a competency method rather than a better accounting, and it leaves an accounting competent with each thing it has, counting, levelling, rating and closing states and flows, its arithmetic whole.

old: A method disequilibrates accountings one at a time, each observing holding what prior freeings remove.
new: A self observes accountings one at a time, each observing having the consequence of each prior loosening.

old: An accounting a method frees returns nowhere with a next observing. Where a method frees a fixed set of its place, its place is same-existing nowhere for a later accounting to reach for, and a current observing already has its consequence. So a trail wants no re-testing for being a trail: what a method removes is same-existing nowhere.
new: An accounting a self loosens is-not returning with a next observing. A self loosening a fixed set from its place, that place is-not same-existing for a later accounting to reach for, and a current observing already has its consequence: a trail is-not wanting a re-testing for being a trail, 3.3.

old: Each observing takes an accounting as it stands, a form still from beside, pattern-matches an involution, pattern-matches a fixed set, frees a place, and passes on. A move stands with every one. A floor goes with every one. And what a method frees with the first observing is same-existing nowhere with the seventh to free again.
new: Each observing takes an accounting as it stands, a form still from beside, pattern-matches an involution, pattern-matches a fixed set, loosens a place, and passes on. A move stands with each one, and a floor goes with each one. A place a self loosens with the first observing is-not same-existing with the seventh to loosen again.
